title: Which Way Does Time Flow? A Psychophysics-Grounded Evaluation for Vision–Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on a balanced dataset of forward and backward playing video clips (AoT-PsyPhyBENCH) and comparing class-specific F1 scores and recall to identify disproportionate preferences for one temporal direction (e.g., 'Forward' or 'Backward').
